title: Statistical Analysis of the Sinkhorn Iterations for Two-Sample Schrödinger Bridge Estimation
tldr_zh: 两样本 Sinkhorn bridge 的 TV² 误差 O(1/m+1/n+r^{4k})；[SF]²M/LightSB(-M)/DSBM-IMF/BM² 的最优估计量与之相同
tldr_en: Two-sample Sinkhorn bridge error is O(1/m+1/n+r^{4k}) in squared TV; [SF]2M, LightSB(-M), DSBM-IMF and BM2 share this estimator and hence the guarantee.
key_numbers: Statistical rate O(1/m+1/n) with constant (R/eps)^{9 d_nu+4} (Theorem 1, Eq. 14)
Improves n^{-1/2} of Pooladian & Niles-Weed 2024 to n^{-1} (Remark 1)
Toy experiments only: 3D Gaussian (eps=0.1, 0.005), eight-Gaussians->moons with 1000 samples (Sec. 4)
